$comment: Line-by-line review of the repository at the point work began, plus what was added. Recorded so the build can be audited without re-reading the git history.

findings.finding: The repository contains no prior work. The brief describes an existing source register, rows SG-27..SG-30, flags FLG-003 and sections S01/S07/S24. None exist in any commit or branch.
findings.verified_by: git ls-tree -r main, git log --all --name-only, and a file-count of every remote branch
findings.action_taken: Registers re-established forward on this branch with the brief's identifiers, marked 'newly created' rather than 'restored'. Logged as FLG-007.

findings.finding: Nine sibling arena/*-affil3 branches exist on origin, all containing only README.md + COORDINATION.md, committed 05:09-05:13Z. Two of them (772f3220, and this one) claim the same docs/ and register/ paths. No COORDINATION.md on main means there is no arbitration point.
findings.verified_by: git for-each-ref + git ls-tree per branch
findings.action_taken: Claim pushed before any edit; overlap logged in COORDINATION.md and as FLG-009. No sibling file was modified.

findings.finding: No CI, no Pages configuration, no .gitignore, no lockfile, no dependencies, and no build system. Nothing to break, but also nothing to inherit - the toolchain had to be created rather than extended.
findings.action_taken: Zero-dependency Node toolchain added (scripts/*.mjs) plus .github/workflows/ci.yml, deliberately avoiding an npm install in CI.

findings.finding: Sandbox egress is limited to github.com, codeload, api.github, npmjs and PyPI. Direct curl to amazon.com fails at TLS (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL), so all Amazon observation in this session was made through the platform's page fetcher.
findings.verified_by: curl to www.amazon.com returned http_code=000 with a TLS error; the same fetcher resolved amazon.com pages successfully
findings.action_taken: Every Amazon-side observation records the fetch method, and nothing that could not be fetched is claimed. Two fetches failed three times each (USDA page, PA-API docs) and are recorded as such rather than retried into a confident-sounding claim.

findings.finding: The five product links in the brief use the host link.amazon with a 9-character path. This is not a documented Associates link format, and the strings are not valid ASINs, yet the host does resolve and does redirect to live listings.
findings.verified_by: string measurement plus four successful resolutions and one checkpoint interstitial
findings.action_taken: Tokens and resolved ASINs stored in separate fields (CTL-11). Site built on generated /dp/?tag= links. FLG-001, FLG-003, FLG-004.

findings.finding: No brand asset, no domain, no audience data, no keyword dataset and no Associates credentials accompany the repo. Four of the five question sections in register/questions.json exist because of this.
findings.verified_by: repo contents plus the brief itself
findings.action_taken: Brand derived from the tracking ID and labelled as derived (SG-25). No market or traffic claim is made anywhere (FLG-010).

what_was_added.published_at: shopnow/ (mounted under /shop/ because Pages publishes main:/ and the root and /editorial/ surfaces were already owned by sibling sessions)
